content.json:
## CTL Agent ù Verdict Evidence & Audit Trail

End-to-end audit trail for every Clear-To-List evaluation. Pick a **Session** below to see the orchestrator phases, sub-agent reasoning, MCP tool calls, RAG citations, and the final verdict ù with its evidence chain.

*Source: `customEvents` (event = `CTL.AuditStep`) emitted by the CTL Agent Host into Application Insights `ctlagent-appinsights`.*

parameters.name: SessionId
parameters.label: Session
parameters.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'CTL.AuditStep'
| extend SessionId = tostring(customDimensions.SessionId), AssetId = tostring(customDimensions.AssetId)
| summarize Started = min(timestamp), Steps = count(), AssetId = anyif(AssetId, AssetId != 'ù' and isnotempty(AssetId)) by SessionId
| order by Started desc
| project value = SessionId, label = strcat(SessionId, '   ╖   ', coalesce(AssetId, 'ù'), '   ╖   ', format_datetime(Started, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), ' UTC   ╖   ', tostring(Steps), ' steps')

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'CTL.AuditStep'
| where tostring(customDimensions.SessionId) == '{SessionId}'
| extend Step = tostring(customDimensions.StepType), Description = tostring(customDimensions.Description), AssetId = tostring(customDimensions.AssetId), Agent = tostring(customDimensions.AgentName)
| summarize
    Asset = anyif(AssetId, AssetId != 'ù' and isnotempty(AssetId)),
    Started = min(timestamp),
    Completed = max(timestamp),
    Steps = count(),
    Verdict = anyif(Description, Step == 'EvaluationCompleted'),
    HumanReview = countif(Step in ('HumanReviewRequested','HumanReviewSubmitted')) > 0,
    SafetyDegraded = countif(Step in ('ContentSafetyDegraded','CircuitBreakerOpen')) > 0,
    Failures = countif(Step == 'AgentExhaustedRetries')
| extend DurationSec = datetime_diff('second', Completed, Started)
| project Asset, Started, DurationSec, Steps, Verdict, HumanReview, SafetyDegraded, Failures

content.json:
### Phase Timeline

Duration of each orchestrator phase (Planning ΓåÆ Investigation ΓåÆ Reflection ΓåÆ Quality Gate).

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'CTL.AuditStep'
| where tostring(customDimensions.SessionId) == '{SessionId}'
| extend Agent = tostring(customDimensions.AgentName), Step = tostring(customDimensions.StepType)
| where Agent startswith 'CTLOrchestrator-' or Agent == 'CTLWorkflowOrchestrator'
| where Step in ('PhaseStarted','PhaseCompleted','EvaluationCompleted','AssetProfileSupplied')
| project timestamp, Phase = replace_string(Agent, 'CTLOrchestrator-', ''), Step, Description = tostring(customDimensions.Description)
| order by timestamp asc

content.json:
### Audit Trail ù every step

Click the Γû╢ on any row to expand it as a card (no horizontal scroll).

**Legend:** `[Orchestrator ╖ Deterministic]` = workflow control ╖ `[LLM ...]` = model reasoning ╖ `[LLM Tool Call]` = MCP tool invocation ╖ `[Guardrail ╖ ...]` = safety filter ╖ `[Human Review]` = manual reviewer.

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'CTL.AuditStep'
| where tostring(customDimensions.SessionId) == '{SessionId}'
| extend Time  = format_datetime(timestamp, 'HH:mm:ss.fff'),
         Agent = tostring(customDimensions.AgentName),
         Step  = tostring(customDimensions.StepType),
         Description = tostring(customDimensions.Description),
         Payload     = tostring(customDimensions.OutputPayload),
         Tokens      = todouble(customMeasurements.TokensUsed),
         DurationMs  = todouble(customMeasurements.DurationMs)
| project timestamp, Time, Agent, Step, Description, Tokens, DurationMs, Payload
| order by timestamp asc

customEvents
| where name == 'CTL.AuditStep'
| where tostring(customDimensions.SessionId) == '{SessionId}'
| where tostring(customDimensions.StepType) == 'ToolCallExecuted'
| extend Time = format_datetime(timestamp, 'HH:mm:ss.fff'),
         Agent = tostring(customDimensions.AgentName),
         Description = tostring(customDimensions.Description),
         Payload     = tostring(customDimensions.OutputPayload)
| project timestamp, Time, Agent, Description, Payload
| order by timestamp asc

content.json:
### Guardrails ù safety screening events

Content Safety, Prompt Shields, PII filter, Token Budget. Each row proves a guardrail ran on every input/output.

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'CTL.AuditStep'
| where tostring(customDimensions.SessionId) == '{SessionId}'
| where tostring(customDimensions.AgentName) startswith 'GuardrailsMiddleware'
| extend Time = format_datetime(timestamp, 'HH:mm:ss.fff'),
         Agent = tostring(customDimensions.AgentName),
         Step  = tostring(customDimensions.StepType),
         Description = tostring(customDimensions.Description)
| project timestamp, Time, Agent, Step, Description
| order by timestamp asc

customEvents
| where name == 'CTL.AuditStep'
| extend SessionId = tostring(customDimensions.SessionId),
         AssetId   = tostring(customDimensions.AssetId),
         Step      = tostring(customDimensions.StepType),
         Description = tostring(customDimensions.Description)
| summarize
    Asset      = anyif(AssetId, AssetId != 'ù' and isnotempty(AssetId)),
    Started    = min(timestamp),
    Steps      = count(),
    Verdict    = anyif(Description, Step == 'EvaluationCompleted'),
    Failures   = countif(Step == 'AgentExhaustedRetries')
  by SessionId
| order by Started desc
| take 50
